sections.Profile:
Bird Watcher, developed by Ian Harrower Games and released in 2023, is a tranquil, timed add-on game for Multimorphic's P³ Pinball Platform. In this game, players assume the role of a twitcher—a dedicated bird enthusiast—tasked with locating and photographing various bird species before the camera's battery depletes.
